business_summary: Shikibo Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, and markets textile products in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Textiles; Industrial Materials; Functional raw materials; and Real Estate and Services. The company offers various yarns, fabrics, textiles, knitwear, and secondary products used for general clothing, shirts, sportswear, casual wear, and uniform, as well as bed and bedding. It also provides industrial materials, such as dryer canvas used for paper, cardboard, and food production, as well as filter clothes; and composite materials comprising fiber reinforced materials, glass fiber reinforced plastics, carbon fiber reinforced plastics, and others; and industrial adhesive for electronic boards production. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacture, processing and marketing of various textile and chemical industry products; and transactions, leasing, and management of real estate, as well as rental of commercial buildings, apartments, mixed bathing facilities, warehouses, and logistics; operation of Shikibo Hall; supply of linen to hotels and home cleaning; distribution businesses; and engages in solar power generation. It exports its products. Shikibo Ltd. was incorporated in 1892 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
